amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.point: SPP may amend because no FERC or delegated order has issued on the November 6 filing.
amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: Amendment of the November 6 Filing is permitted because no Commission or delegated order has been issued in the docket.

amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.point: SPP says it inadvertently omitted revisions to the Upper Missouri Zone rate sheet.
amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: SPP inadvertently omitted revisions to the rate sheet for the Upper Missouri Zone to add references to Schedule 14 and Incremental Market Efficiency Use revenues.

amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.point: SPP keeps Attachment AU references on this sheet because the zone includes SPP East Region utilities.
amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: because the Upper Missouri Zone includes utilities in the SPP East Region.

amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.point: SPP requests no other changes and the same effective date.
amendment-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: SPP is not requesting any other amendments or modifications to the November 6 Filing.

filing-er27-432-spp-chills.point: SPP adds CHILLS provisions for West Region pricing zones and makes clarifying edits.
filing-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: to add provisions for Conditional High Impact Large Load Service (“CHILLS”) for pricing Zones in the SPP West Region, and to make other clarifying edits.

filing-er27-432-spp-chills.point: CHILLS lets High Impact Large Loads take non-firm conditional transmission service; FERC accepted it in earlier orders.
filing-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: SPP submitted revisions to the Tariff to add CHILLS to allow High Impact Large Loads (“HILL”) to be served with non-firm conditional transmission service.

filing-er27-432-spp-chills.point: The CHILLS filing predated the West Region pricing zones, which came with the April 1, 2026 RTO expansion.
filing-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: At the time of the CHILLS Filing, the new pricing Zones for the SPP West Region had not yet been established in the Tariff.

filing-er27-432-spp-chills.point: SPP adds Zones 100 to 104 to Schedule 15.
filing-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: SPP proposes to add pricing Zones 100, 101, 102, 103, and 104 under Section 1 of Schedule 15

filing-er27-432-spp-chills.point: Point-to-point rates will be adjusted for Schedule 15 revenues, and mistaken Attachment AU references are removed for CSU and Platte River.
filing-er27-432-spp-chills.quote: SPP adds a reference to Schedule 15 to appropriately adjust the Point-To-Point Transmission Service Rates for any revenues received for Schedule 15 charges.
